target: Spoiler-free 100% completion: discoveries, relationships, Abbey systems, combat records, balance rewards, campaign, and DLC

areas.name: Completion Run Planner
areas.location_cue: Use this checklist at the Mirror Table before advancing the main objective and again before starting New Game+.
areas.note: The campaign remains playable after its final mission. Most cleanup is safest on the original clear file.

save_backup.title: Keep the completed campaign save
save_backup.why: New Game+ resets Abbey exploration, research, facility construction, and one-campaign counters.
save_backup.detail: Make a separate manual save before selecting New Game+ and never overwrite the original post-campaign file.

levels.1: Treat the first campaign as the permanent exploration and relationship file.
levels.2: Before the final mission, finish every Grounds region, club chain, Haven, hero friendship, and facility upgrade that is available.
levels.3: Use repeatable general missions to advance days without advancing the main objective. Complete all four Words of Power, permanent collections, fifteen Havens, fifteen club meetings, base and installed-DLC friendships, every research project, and every purchasable Abbey upgrade in this same campaign. The final mission does not lock the save, so unfinished grinding can continue afterward.

levels.1: Commit Hunter's answers and deck to one alignment before changing direction.
levels.2: Reach 200 Light or 200 Dark first and verify every reward on that side before reversing course.
levels.3: Choose dialogue answers marked for the selected side and play four matching Hunter cards per mission for one point, or eight for two. The T.H.R.E.A.T. Room can add another same-day combat opportunity; the Grotto grants Light on a full moon and Dark on a new moon. At 200, verify both collars, the legendary copies, and the suit before earning opposite points.

levels.1: Previously earned alignment rewards remain available after the meter moves away.
levels.2: After reaching one 200-point extreme, reverse every repeatable source until Hunter reaches the opposite 200-point extreme.
levels.3: Keep the original campaign open and swap to an eight-card deck dominated by the opposite alignment. Run general missions and the T.H.R.E.A.T. Room with Hunter, playing eight matching cards whenever possible, and use the correct moon phase at the Grotto. Dialogue is finite, but combat balance is repeatable. Do not start New Game+ merely for this grind unless you intentionally want its reset rules.

levels.1: Do not add an unsupported campaign-setting requirement.
levels.2: Choose any combat difficulty; 100% completion has no separate difficulty clear, time rank, or score rank.
levels.3: Finish the campaign once on any setting. Raising difficulty increases mission rewards but does not add a distinct completion record, ending, or unlock requirement. There is also only one campaign ending, already represented by Campaign Completion.

areas.name: Hunter Balance Rewards
areas.location_cue: Hunter's Hero screen shows the current Light-or-Dark value; new collars, cards, and suits appear automatically at thresholds.
areas.note: Crossing back through neutral does not remove rewards already earned.

save_backup.title: Back up before completing the Garden mystery
save_backup.why: Its legendary-card reward is selected from Hunter's Balance at the completion check.
save_backup.detail: Make a separate manual save before the final Garden interaction, then confirm the intended Balance range on Hunter's Hero screen.

levels.1: One Grounds mystery awards a legendary ability based on current Balance.
levels.2: Complete Hunter's Forge challenge for Bladestorm, then finish the Garden mystery while at least 20 points toward either side for the opposite-side legendary.
levels.3: Hunter's Forge challenge always grants Bladestorm. At the Garden mystery's reward check, 20 or more Light grants Annihilation, 20 or more Dark grants Summon Charlie, and a neutral meter grants another Bladestorm. The 100-point thresholds separately grant the same-side legendary, so all three named abilities can be owned in one campaign.

areas.name: New Game+ Carry-Over
areas.location_cue: The New Game+ option appears after Campaign Completion and asks which updated carry-over categories to enable.
areas.note: Current patched versions provide category toggles; the new campaign still resets world and facility state.

save_backup.title: Preserve the original clear file
save_backup.why: Starting a replay does not preserve every one-campaign checklist or Abbey construction state.
save_backup.detail: Create a new save slot for New Game+ and retain a separate manual post-campaign save for cleanup.

levels.1: Read every toggle instead of assuming the replay imports everything.
levels.2: At New Game+ setup, choose separately whether to retain abilities, friendships, resources, and cosmetics.
levels.3: Use an updated game version, select the completed save, and review all four carry-over categories. Enable Hero Abilities to retain cards, mods, collars, and passives; Friendship Levels for hero and team rewards; Resources for currencies and crafting materials; and Cosmetics for unlocked and purchased appearances.

levels.1: World exploration and facility progress belong to the new campaign.
levels.2: Expect character levels, Abbey exploration, research progress, facility upgrades, and one-campaign counters to reset.
levels.3: Even with every carry-over toggle enabled, rebuild the Abbey route, re-earn Words of Power, raise research and training levels, complete research projects, and purchase facility upgrades again. Collections, Havens, clubs, reagents, keys, gifts, and other campaign-world state should be treated as reset until verified in the new file.

levels.1: The finished campaign remains available for unrestricted general missions.
levels.2: Complete balance, upgrades, friendships, collections, and combat counters on the original save before beginning a replay.
levels.3: After Campaign Completion, load the clear file and continue advancing days with general missions. Finish every single-campaign counter there, especially Abbey upgrades, all Havens, all club meetings, suit palettes, daily sparring partners, Charlie's consecutive petting streak, and both Balance extremes. Start New Game+ only after the checklist is clean.

areas.name: Renewable Exploration
areas.location_cue: Arcane chests and reagent patches distributed through already explored Abbey grounds.
areas.note: These resources respawn or cycle, so the checklist tracks their systems rather than pretending each pickup is permanent.

levels.1: Colored chests appear beside ruins, caves, statues, and solved mysteries.
levels.2: Open every newly revealed chest while sweeping the grounds; previously opened chests can later refill.
levels.3: Use Arcane Keys for locked chests until Arcane Knowledge makes lower-rarity chests free. Because chest contents respawn, a reopened chest is not a missed permanent collectible; prioritize unique mystery reward chests and spend spare keys on unopened high-rarity chests.

levels.1: A rare purple flower appears near magically resonant landmarks on particular nights.
levels.2: On a waxing-moon night, check the Library, major Blood Gates, the southwestern altar, Standing Stones, the far cottage, and the greenhouse garden.
levels.3: Check the moon phase on the map at night, then fast-travel between magical landmarks and collect each glowing Wundagore Everbloom. It is renewable rather than a finite collectible, so repeat this route on later waxing moons if recipes require more.

levels.1: Different plant types favor different sections of the grounds and can return after time passes.
levels.2: After rain or a new night cycle, sweep tree bases, graveyards, caves, and garden edges in each unlocked region.
levels.3: Collect every visible plant during normal exploration, but do not treat empty spawn points as misses. Reagents are crafting materials that repopulate; revisit after missions or weather changes and reserve rare types until their recipe books are unlocked.

areas.name: Hero Friendship

areas.note: Raise every friendship-enabled hero to level 5; Hulk uses research instead of friendship.

levels.1: Spend time with this hero between missions and learn which activities and gifts they enjoy.

areas.name: Forge Challenges
areas.location_cue: The challenge portal inside the Forge after the Armory is built.
areas.note: Each fixed-hand puzzle awards a legendary card and suit; full card orders are kept at level 3.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Hunter's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory from Forged in Hellfire; Hunter's puzzle is available immediately. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Charge the nearest left target toward the upper-left one; Charge the upper-left target to defeat it; push the survivor right through the rocks; defeat the lower-right target with Charge to take position; use the last Charge and then Whip to send the survivor into the red crystal; play Bladestorm on the new black crystal.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Blade's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Blade. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Quick Strike the right card-holder, finish it with Relentless, then play Make 'em Bleed. Split Strike across the two survivors, put every Daywalker chain on the stronger one, Quick Strike the weak one, use Reaper on the bleeding survivor, and finish the spawned crystal with Glaive.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Captain America's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Captain America. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Punch the right card-holder into a pillar, play The Best Defense, then aim Shield Bounce through three weak targets. Play Tactician, Punch the last weak target, and spend both Shield Bashes plus the remaining Punch on the elite. Use the acquired Shield Charge on the crystal.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Captain Marvel's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Captain Marvel. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Play Knee Strike and Cosmic Ray on the target, then knock it into the red crystal with Fists of Radiance. Go Binary, KO the target with Quick Jab, play One Step Ahead, Regroup, and All In, then hit the crystal with Fists of Radiance and Rain of Blows. Use Supernova on the black crystal.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Doctor Strange's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Doctor Strange. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Use Bolt of Balthakk on card-holding targets to collect Blessing of Vishanti and Agamotto's Gaze. Alternate the Gaze draws with both Blessings, then direct every strengthened Bolt into the remaining target and crystal. When Seven Suns of Cinnibus appears, cast it on the black crystal.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Ghost Rider's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Ghost Rider. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Lash the second target into the third, then Lash the fourth into the second. Use Judgement on the clustered pair, Retribution the remaining weak target into rubble, and use Penance Stare on the elite; play the awarded card if the closing target remains.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Hulk's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Research Change of Plans, complete three Hulk missions, upgrade three Hulk abilities, then research Energy Drink. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Gamma Kick the fourth target; follow with Smash and Crush to KO it. Chain Rampage through targets one, two, and three, Gamma Kick target five, play Let's Do This, then Smash once more to reach maximum Rage. Use Worldbreaker on the full group.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Iron Man's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Iron Man. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Redraw New Plan, then play Heads Up, Precision, and Leave It to Me. Put the eight-hit Surgical Strike into the red crystal, play the next Heads Up, use the six-hit Surgical Strike, and fire all three Blasts at the crystal. Finish the spawned crystal with Hellfire Beam.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Magik's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Magik. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Play Limbo's Grasp, place a Limbo Portal at the green hazard, and Quick Soul Slash the central target through it. Use Trap Door, detonate the red hazard, then alternate Kick, Trap Door, and Soul Blast to collide the surviving target with its neighbors. Play Darkchylde and end the turn.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Nico Minoru's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Nico Minoru. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Redraw Blood Magic for Double Up, play both Double Ups, then redraw Empower and cast the new Blood Magic on Nico. Put one Witchstorm into each pair of untouched targets and play both Witchfires to clean up. Use Crack the Sky when it appears.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Scarlet Witch's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Scarlet Witch. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Use both Quick Toss cards to pull the two distant targets into Wanda's radius. Cast Hex Field twice, then chain successive Hex Bolts through targets three, two, four, and one while collecting the replacement Bolts. Finish the elite with No More.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Spider-Man's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Spider-Man. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Play Opportunist. Use the low coffin to knock the elite into one weak target, then the left coffin into the second. Throw the last weak target into the elite with Special Delivery and use the remaining coffin to finish it. Play Infernal Spider, then empty the free follow-up cards into the crystal.

levels.1: A fixed-hand Forge puzzle rewards careful card order rather than a normal combat build.
levels.2: At the Forge challenge portal, select Wolverine's unlocked challenge.
levels.3: Build the Armory, complete Hunter's challenge, and reach Friendship Level 5 with Wolverine. Number ordinary targets left-to-right before acting. Put every Lethal Pounce chain on the nearer right target for Strengthened. Split Chain Swipes across the two right targets, Power Slash each left target into the short wall, and use Stink of Fear on the left pair. Play Let's Do This, split Eviscerate two-and-two across the survivors, then use Midnight Special.

areas.name: Base Completion Records
areas.location_cue: Track these through the corresponding Forge, Yard, War Room, Hero, customization, and combat menus.
areas.note: These are game-internal completion actions and collection records.

save_backup.title: Protect one-campaign counters
save_backup.why: Several counters must be completed without moving to a new campaign.
save_backup.detail: Finish all entries marked missable on the original post-campaign save before opening New Game+.

levels.1: Try the Forge's consumable workstation once.
levels.2: Craft one combat item at the Item Bench.
levels.3: Research and purchase Item Bench, interact with it in the Forge, choose any recipe whose ingredients are available, and confirm one crafted combat item enters inventory.

levels.1: Blueprints can create a chosen hero card directly.
levels.2: Craft one hero ability at the Forge.
levels.3: Unlock Ability Crafting, open its Forge station, choose a hero and an affordable discovered ability, spend the required Blueprint and Essence, and collect the finished card.

levels.1: A Grounds workstation turns reagents into useful supplies.
levels.2: Complete one recipe at Agatha's Cauldron.
levels.3: Unlock the Cauldron through Grounds progress, collect the displayed reagents, select any known recipe, and brew it once; reading a recipe book without brewing does not complete the action.

levels.1: The bedroom has its own Gloss-funded customization list.
levels.2: Purchase ten different upgrades for Hunter's room.
levels.3: Interact with ten separate furniture or decor positions in Hunter's room and buy a distinct option at each. Color variants at one position do not replace ten different room fixtures.

levels.1: Keep studying Artifacts even after the essential facilities are open.
levels.2: Complete every available base-game and installed-DLC project at the Forge.
levels.3: Raise Research Level by studying Artifacts, inspect each locked project's champion requirement, and deploy or upgrade the named hero until it is met. Research one project per day, claim it the following morning, and continue until every base tab and each installed DLC portrait has a completed mark. Purchase the upgrades separately afterward.

levels.1: Research alone does not build a facility improvement.
levels.2: Build every Forge, Yard, and War Room upgrade in one campaign.
levels.3: Study Artifacts, finish each prerequisite, claim its research, and spend Credits on the resulting construction. Verify Forge: Item Bench I-III, Foundry I-II, Book of the Vishanti, Armory, Articulated Arm, Empowered Anvil, and Cauldron of the Cosmos. Verify Yard: Combat Therapy, Crucible, Legendary Blade, Teamwork Tactics I-II, T.H.R.E.A.T. Room, Training Dummies: Shove, and Training Dummies: Cure. Verify War Room: S.H.I.E.L.D. Exchange, S.T.R.I.K.E. Terminal, and Kree Processor. With DLC installed, also build Food Truck, Whisper Web, Laboratory I-II, and Enhanced T.H.R.E.A.T. Room I-II before New Game+.

levels.1: Group friendship grows through individual bonds and shared activities.
levels.2: Raise Team Friendship to its maximum level in one campaign.
levels.3: Earn Friendship XP through Hangouts, Havens, gifts, Compliments, club meetings, and dialogue. Claim each Team Friendship reward at the central level-up display and continue until the team meter shows its maximum.

levels.1: Respawning chests make this a cumulative opening counter.
levels.2: Open Arcane Chests twenty-five times.
levels.3: Raise Arcane Knowledge through exploration so lower-rarity chests become free, revisit opened chest locations after they reset, and perform twenty-five opening interactions. Unique chest locations are not required.

levels.1: Rotate the Yard's daily partner instead of repeating favorites.
levels.2: Complete Daily Sparring once with every available hero.
levels.3: Each day, use Daily Sparring at the Yard with a hero not yet checked. Track the full base roster and installed DLC roster manually; only one partner is available per day, so advance with general missions and finish before New Game+.

levels.1: A daily Abbey interaction must remain unbroken.
levels.2: Pet Charlie on fifteen consecutive in-game days.
levels.3: Find Charlie after every wake-up and interact until the pet animation completes before starting the next mission. Keep a manual day count; missing one day resets the streak, while post-campaign general missions provide unlimited recovery time.

levels.1: A second Abbey animal appears only on some nights.
levels.2: Pet Ebony on four different in-game days.
levels.3: Listen for the arrival cue and inspect the Abbey interior, chapel, library, and nearby common areas at night. Pet Ebony whenever found and repeat on four separate days; duplicate interactions on one day count once.

levels.1: Hunter's full card pool spans Power, Light, and Dark branches.
levels.2: Acquire at least one copy of every Hunter ability.
levels.3: Analyze Gamma Coils, craft missing discovered cards, finish Hunter's challenge, reach both Balance reward tracks, and use the Garden mystery reward strategically. Compare the Ability Crafting list against owned Hunter cards until every ability is represented.

levels.1: Delay mass brewing until every ingredient stack reaches double digits.
levels.2: Hold or collect ten of every Grounds reagent type.
levels.3: Sweep all Grounds regions by day and night, including moon-phase-only Wundagore Everbloom spawns, until the cumulative requirement for every reagent reaches ten. Avoid spending scarce stacks at the Cauldron until the record registers.

levels.1: Each recruited hero needs one alternate palette actively applied.
levels.2: During one campaign, equip a nondefault combat-suit color on each hero.
levels.3: Open Customization for each available base and installed-DLC hero, select a combat suit, and apply any nondefault unlocked palette. Repeat for the full active roster before New Game+; merely unlocking a palette is insufficient.

levels.1: The first portrait at the Mirror Table rotates the mission leader.
levels.2: Use every hero as leader for at least one completed general mission.
levels.3: At the Mirror Table, choose general missions whose required leader has not yet been checked, complete the objective, and return to the Abbey. Repeat for every base and installed-DLC hero; story missions do not substitute reliably.

levels.1: The training portal tracks heroes separately.
levels.2: Survive all three T.H.R.E.A.T. Room turns with every hero.
levels.3: Unlock the T.H.R.E.A.T. Room, enter with one unchecked hero per day, and survive through the third turn. Use Quick and chain-KO cards to maintain Card Plays, then repeat for every base and installed-DLC hero before New Game+.

levels.1: Hunter's wardrobe provides a large Gloss sink.
levels.2: Spend a total of 1,500 Gloss on Hunter cosmetics.
levels.3: Buy Hunter outfits, room clothes, face props, and palettes from Customization until the cumulative spend reaches 1,500 Gloss. Purchases for other heroes do not advance this total.

levels.1: Save a Quick attack for a named target's final health.
levels.2: KO a villain with a Quick ability.
levels.3: Lower the villain until a Quick card's displayed damage is lethal, then use that card for the KO. Quick's Card Play refund is irrelevant; the final hit must come from the Quick ability.

levels.1: Line enemies up with one shove repeatedly.
levels.2: KO multiple enemies with one Knockback twenty-five times.
levels.3: Use Forceful Knockback, directional knockbacks, or shove angles that send one target into another and KO at least two enemies from the same action. Repeat until the cumulative counter reaches twenty-five.

levels.1: Use spare redraws every mission.
levels.2: Redraw a total of seventy-five cards.
levels.3: During combat, select unwanted cards and use Redraw whenever charges remain. Card effects that redraw also help only if the game records them; the safest method is the standard Redraw command across missions.

levels.1: Free and Quick cards stretch the normal Card Play limit.
levels.2: Play eight hero abilities during one turn.
levels.3: Build a hand with Quick attacks that secure KOs, Free cards, Marked targets, and Card Play refunds. In one turn, resolve eight hero cards before ending the turn; moves, items, and environment attacks are not hero abilities.

levels.1: Research enables post-KO questioning opportunities.
levels.2: Interrogate five enemies across missions.
levels.3: Complete the Truth Serum research and install its War Room upgrade. When an Interrogate card appears after an eligible enemy is downed, spend a Card Play on it; repeat five times across missions.

items.label: Two Drop KOs in One Turn

levels.1: Open ledges can remove two targets without raw damage.
levels.2: Knock two enemies into Drops during one turn.
levels.3: On a map with two open Drop edges, weaken targets if necessary, then use knockback cards, moves, or shoves to send two enemies over marked Drop boundaries before ending the same turn.

levels.1: Choose a short objective and front-load damage.
levels.2: Complete any general mission in two turns or fewer.
levels.3: Lower difficulty if needed, bring upgraded burst decks and combat items, and select a simple general mission. Finish its actual objective by the end of turn two; surviving an additional required wave would exceed the limit.

levels.1: Save a Combo card for a named target.
levels.2: KO a villain with a Hero Combo.
levels.3: Build Friendship until Hero Combo cards appear, lower the villain below a Combo card's previewed damage, then spend the Heroism and use that Combo for the final hit.

levels.1: Bank Heroism and leave props intact for one crowded turn.
levels.2: Use five environmental attacks during one turn.
levels.3: Enter a room with several usable props, build enough Heroism, and perform five separate environmental attacks before ending the turn. Reusing a prop is allowed only if it remains interactable.

levels.1: Buy optional objectives before launching general missions.
levels.2: Complete ten purchased Mission Challenges.
levels.3: Unlock the S.H.I.E.L.D. Exchange, buy a Challenge for a general mission, meet its condition, and finish the mission successfully. Repeat until ten challenge rewards are collected; failed conditions do not count.

levels.1: Defense, Conceal, Resist, and fast objective play prevent health loss.
levels.2: Finish a general mission with no hero taking Health damage.
levels.3: Use a low-difficulty general mission, conceal or protect targeted heroes, remove marked attackers first, and finish the objective before any hit penetrates Block or Resist. Health damage from any teammate invalidates the attempt.

levels.1: A single explosive or heavy prop needs a tightly packed group.
levels.2: KO four enemies with one environmental attack.
levels.3: On a reinforcement-heavy map, weaken four minions near one explosive, pole, or large environmental. Confirm all four lie inside the preview and trigger that one environmental for all four KOs.

items.label: Three Legendary Abilities in One Mission

levels.1: Bring three heroes whose legendary cards are already unlocked.
levels.2: Use three different Legendary abilities during one mission.
levels.3: Equip one Legendary card in each hero's deck, bring those three heroes together, draw and play all three named cards before completing the mission. Duplicate copies or a single hero's repeated card do not count as three different abilities.

levels.1: The Yard can add a random modifier to upgraded cards.
levels.2: Apply mods to ten different hero abilities.
levels.3: Research and build the Crucible, upgrade ten distinct ability cards, then use Apply Ability Mods at the Yard on each. Re-rolling one card repeatedly does not replace ten different abilities.

levels.1: One high-cost ability can consume a full Heroism bank.
levels.2: Spend ten Heroism with a single ability.
levels.3: Equip a scalable or ten-cost Heroic ability, build Heroism to at least ten, and play it when its displayed cost is ten. Several smaller cards totaling ten do not count.

levels.1: Use consumables steadily instead of hoarding them.
levels.2: Use twenty-five combat items across missions.
levels.3: Equip combat items before deployment and activate them during encounters until twenty-five total uses register. Craft or buy replacements; carrying an item through a mission without activating it does not count.

areas.name: Installed DLC Completion Records
areas.location_cue: These entries apply only when the corresponding character packs are installed and their opening missions appear at the Mirror Table.
areas.note: Finish all four character packs on one campaign before the combined closing mission becomes available.

levels.1: Follow one installed character's purple missions to their own conclusion.
levels.2: Complete every Deadpool story mission.
levels.3: Select each Deadpool-marked mission whenever it appears, complete its objective, then advance days until the next entry unlocks. Continue until his chain reports complete.

levels.1: His missions unlock several themed Forge projects.
levels.2: Complete every Deadpool research project and build its upgrade.
levels.3: Use Deadpool often enough to satisfy each displayed champion requirement, raise Research Level as needed, complete every project bearing his portrait, and purchase the Food Truck upgrade those projects unlock.

levels.1: Chain Deadpool KOs without letting incoming hits erase momentum.
levels.2: Reach Deadpool's maximum En Fuego level during combat.
levels.3: Use Deadpool to secure the required KOs for each En Fuego step while Taunting away from him, Concealing him, or removing his attackers. Continue in one encounter until the meter reaches its maximum.

levels.1: Complete the full purple mission sequence for the symbiote character.
levels.2: Complete every Venom story mission.
levels.3: Select and finish each Venom-marked mission, advance days when the next entry is not yet present, and continue until his character chain reports complete.

levels.1: His completed missions and deployments unlock themed projects.
levels.2: Complete every Venom research project and build its upgrade.
levels.3: Meet each displayed Venom usage requirement, claim every portrait-marked project at the Forge, and spend Credits to build the Whisper Web in the War Room.

levels.1: Venom's meter must visit both extremes in one encounter.
levels.2: Completely spend and then refill Ravenous during one encounter.
levels.3: Use Venom abilities that consume Ravenous until the meter is empty, then secure enough Venom KOs or trigger his refill effects to return it to maximum before the encounter ends.

levels.1: A War Room upgrade can alter general mission conditions.
levels.2: Use the Whisper Web to modify five general missions.
levels.3: Build the Whisper Web, interact with it before choosing a general mission, apply one offered modifier, and complete that mission. Repeat on five separate general missions.

levels.1: Complete the full purple mission sequence for the laboratory character.
levels.2: Complete every Morbius story mission.
levels.3: Select and finish every Morbius-marked mission, advancing days as needed between entries, until his character chain reports complete.

levels.1: His deployments unlock projects and a stat laboratory.
levels.2: Complete every Morbius research project and build its upgrade.
levels.3: Meet each displayed Morbius usage requirement, claim all of his Forge projects, and purchase Laboratory and its available improvement before leaving the campaign.

levels.1: The Laboratory's daily treatment should rotate among heroes.
levels.2: Apply a Laboratory stat modification to five different heroes.
levels.3: Build the Laboratory, select one hero and complete a stat treatment, then advance a day and choose a different hero. Repeat until five unique heroes have received a completed modification.

levels.1: Activate Morbius's stance immediately and keep it from expiring.
levels.2: Use Bloodlust on turn one and retain it through the mission.
levels.3: Draw or fetch Bloodlust on the first turn, play it before ending that turn, and refresh or preserve its duration with Morbius's card effects until the final objective completes. Letting the status disappear invalidates the attempt.

levels.1: Prioritize biting enemies and block their marked attacks.
levels.2: Finish a Vampyre mission without any hero receiving Bleed from a bite.
levels.3: Use Resist, Block, Conceal, Taunt control, and fast KOs to prevent every Vampyre Bite from landing on Health. Finish the mission and verify no hero ever gained the bite-applied Bleed status.

levels.1: Complete the full purple mission sequence for the weather character.
levels.2: Complete every Storm story mission.
levels.3: Select and finish every Storm-marked mission, advancing days between entries when necessary, until her character chain reports complete.

levels.1: Her missions unlock projects and a training-room improvement.
levels.2: Complete every Storm research project and build its upgrade.
levels.3: Meet each displayed Storm usage requirement, claim all portrait-marked Forge projects, and purchase the Enhanced T.H.R.E.A.T. Room improvement.

levels.1: Hold delayed Storm abilities until three bonuses are charged together.
levels.2: Play three Storm abilities with active Next Turn bonuses in one turn.
levels.3: Retain three cards bearing Next Turn text for at least one full turn without playing them. On the following turn, confirm each bonus is lit and play all three before ending the turn.

levels.1: Group targets and combine Storm's stun effects in one turn.
levels.2: Stun four enemies with Storm abilities during one turn.
levels.3: Bring Storm cards that apply Stun directly or through area and knockback effects, gather four valid enemies, then apply Storm-sourced Stun to all four before the turn ends.

levels.1: A final DLC operation appears only after all character chains are complete.
levels.2: Complete every Deadpool, Venom, Morbius, and Storm mission, then finish the combined closing mission.
levels.3: On one save with all four packs installed, finish each character's full purple mission chain. Advance a day, check the Mirror Table for the new combined mission, complete it, and return to the Abbey to register the DLC campaign closure.

areas.name: Mission Table Safety Check
areas.location_cue: The Mirror Table and the explicit on-screen lock warning shown before the closing operation.
areas.note: The campaign presents one ending rather than branching endings; make a manual backup when the lock warning appears.

levels.1: The Mirror Table eventually displays a large lock warning before a long operation.
levels.2: When the explicit lock warning appears at the Mirror Table, stop before accepting and make a separate manual save.
levels.3: There is one campaign ending and no light/dark ending branch to collect. After the backup, accept the warned operation and finish its connected missions; after the credits, load the continuation state for remaining Abbey exploration and friendship cleanup.

save_backup.title: Back up your save at the lock warning
save_backup.why: The next operation temporarily suspends Abbey free-roam and social activities.
save_backup.detail: Keep a separate manual save before accepting the warning; the game later returns you to a cleanup state, but the backup protects the single-run checklist.

point_of_no_return.title: Temporary point of no return
point_of_no_return.why: Accepting the large on-screen warning begins a locked sequence of missions.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish any desired social meetings and make the backup first. Exploration collectibles can still be cleaned up after completion.

areas.name: Research Project Catalog
areas.location_cue: The research terminal beside the Forge work area.
areas.note: Meet each project's stated research-level and hero-operation gate, then spend one day completing it at the Forge.

levels.1: Revisit the Forge after hero operations and research-level increases.
levels.2: Find A Balanced Diet in the Forge research list and satisfy the prerequisite shown beside it.
levels.3: At the Forge terminal, highlight A Balanced Diet; complete its listed hero operation or research-level gate, start the project, advance one in-game day, and collect its upgrade. If it remains absent, finish the associated hero's next operation and check again the following morning.

areas.name: Gift Catalog
areas.location_cue: The Abbey gift shop, Arcane Chests, and glowing pickup points around common rooms.
areas.note: Acquire each named gift at least once; giving it away still counts after its collection entry has been seen.

levels.1: Check the rotating gift shelf and small glowing objects after each day.
levels.2: Acquire one copy of A Stoic Companion from the Abbey's gift sources.
levels.3: After the gift shop opens, inspect its rotating stock each day and buy A Stoic Companion when offered. Also open Arcane Chests and collect Abbey pickups, which supply gifts outside the shop rotation. Once its name has appeared in inventory, it may be given to any suitable hero without losing completion credit.
